description.message: Play your ongoing Lichess game in a small always-on-top window while you work in other apps.

buttonOpen.message: Show the board in a floating window that stays on top (Alt+P)

buttonClose.message: Put the board back in this tab (Alt+P)

errorUnsupported.message: Floating windows are not supported in this browser (Chrome 116+ required)

errorBoardNotFound.message: Board not found. Lichess may have changed its layout.
